appDesc.message: Navigate long Gemini chats with an interactive timeline. Optionally add your local time to prompts (off by default).
appDesc.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store and the extensions page.

sidebarLabel.description: Accessible label for the sidebar navigation landmark.

listLabel.description: Accessible label for the message outline list.

toggleOutline.description: Accessible label for the expand/collapse toggle button.

expandOutline.description: Tooltip for the toggle button when the outline is collapsed.

collapseOutline.description: Tooltip for the toggle button when the outline is expanded.

prevMessage.description: Accessible label for the up navigation arrow.

nextMessage.description: Accessible label for the down navigation arrow.

emptyPreview.description: Placeholder shown for a message that has no readable text.

noMessages.description: Shown in the outline when there are no user messages.

jumpToMessage.description: Accessible label for a timeline item. $index$ is the 1-based position.

injectionOn.description: Sidebar time-context status control label when enabled.

injectionOff.description: Sidebar time-context status control label when disabled.

injectionOnHint.message: On: your local time is sent to Google with each request. Click to turn off.
injectionOnHint.description: Tooltip when time context is enabled.

injectionOffHint.message: Off: your Gemini requests are not modified. Click to turn on.
injectionOffHint.description: Tooltip when time context is disabled.

popupEnableLabel.description: Title of the time-context toggle in the popup.

popupEnableDesc.message: Adds your local date, time, and UTC offset (e.g. [System Time: 2026-06-18 21:34 +08:00]) to the prompts you send, so Gemini can better understand timing. This is sent to Google with your request. Off by default.
popupEnableDesc.description: Description of the time-context toggle in the popup.

popupPrecisionLabel.description: Title of the precision option in the popup.

popupPrecisionDesc.message: Minute is gentler on privacy; second helps with log triage.
popupPrecisionDesc.description: Description of the precision option in the popup.

popupPrivacyNote.message: Only the time and UTC offset are added — no location, account, or device info, and nothing is sent to any server other than Gemini itself. The extension keeps the prefix hidden in the page UI to reduce visual clutter; the timestamp remains part of the prompt context sent to Gemini.
popupPrivacyNote.description: Privacy note at the bottom of the popup.

firstRunBody.message: Time Context is off by default. When enabled, ChronoNav adds your current local time to messages you send to Gemini, helping it better understand when things happen. You can turn it off anytime with the clock icon.
